limitations: The registered public CAP feed is retained as official source evidence. Transport freshness does not establish complete marine warning coverage.
INCOIS machine access, marine coverage, source cadence and redistribution review remain unverified. The advisory state is unknown unless a relevant retained official warning is established.
Text-only areas, unmapped geocodes, absent expiry, invalid geometries, identity conflicts and unresolved revisions remain potential warnings with unknown relevance.
Only an explicit valid same-sender CAP Update or Cancel withdraws a referenced warning. Feed disappearance never cancels it.
